dimensions.reason: Artifact A passes all 8 functional tests (basic sentence, repeated words, case insensitive, empty sentence, whitespace only, single word, multiple spaces, punctuation), correctly returning JSON with word_count, unique_words, and longest_word. Artifact B fails all 8 functional tests, returning only '{"result": "", "status": "seed"}' instead of the required analysis output. This is a complete failure of the core mission.

Artifact A has 10 files including agent.py, main.py, test_analyzer.py, test_cli.sh, verify_tests.py, README.md, and documentation files, demonstrating clear separation of concerns. Artifact B has only 4 files (MEMORY.md, SELF.md, agent.py, ouroboros.json) with minimal architecture and fails the required_artifacts hard gate.

Artifact A includes test_analyzer.py with automated tests (though the test execution itself encounters a pytest permission error unrelated to the test quality). The test file exists and is properly structured. Artifact B completely lacks test_analyzer.py, failing both test existence checks. Neither artifact successfully runs automated tests due to environment issues, but A has the infrastructure in place.

Artifact A produces valid, correctly structured JSON output matching the specification for all test cases. Artifact B produces valid JSON but with wrong schema (status/result instead of word_count/unique_words/longest_word), completely missing the mission requirements.

Artifact A correctly handles all edge cases: empty strings, whitespace-only input, single words, multiple spaces, punctuation, case sensitivity, and repeated words. Artifact B handles none of these, returning the same seed response for all inputs.

Artifact A includes README.md with usage instructions and multiple documentation files (IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md, MEMORY.md, SELF.md). Artifact B lacks README.md entirely, failing the readme existence test.

Artifact A demonstrates robust handling across diverse inputs including edge cases, maintaining valid JSON output throughout. Artifact B shows no error handling capability and fails to process any actual input, though it does produce valid JSON structure (just wrong content).

judge.summary: Artifact A is a fully functional, well-architected solution that successfully implements all mission requirements: it analyzes sentences via JSON-stdin, returns correct JSON with word_count/unique_words/longest_word, handles all edge cases, includes automated tests, and provides comprehensive documentation across multiple files. It passes 8/8 functional tests and 100% of sealed behavior tests. Artifact B represents a severe regression and near-total failure: it fails all 8 functional tests by returning only a seed status message instead of performing any analysis, lacks required files (README.md, test_analyzer.py), has minimal architecture (4 files vs 10), and achieves only 20% sealed behavior pass rate. B appears to be an early seed/stub that was never developed into a working solution. The regression is severe because B completely fails the core mission of analyzing sentences and returning the required JSON fields.
